item.title: Awarapan 2 box office day 1: Emraan Hashmi starrer opens at Rs 27 crore
item.summary: Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' has achieved a strong opening at the Indian box office. The film earned an estimated Rs 21 crore net on its first day. This collection marks Emraan Hashmi's biggest opening day at the box office. The sequel significantly surpassed the original 'Awarapan's' opening day earnings. Advance bookings and walk-in audiences contributed to the film's successful debut.
